review: Round12 independent read-only backend/content Web and Windows content probe review

checks.evidence: Only exact live Web-origin Manage leases enter; role User denied. Writer session guard binds actual actor to captured lease/generation and checks again before COMMIT. New backend response metadata revalidates the ledger; scopes reject changed identityRevision. Local UI lock remains independent of existing Web leases.

Read/save/receipt/scopes route through bounded writer ObserveContentDay; watermark is persistent and rollback returns WrongDate. Read/replay/pre-COMMIT require current date; backend checks key.date and record.updated_at.date, builds expires_at using next_day(now).date with second_of_day=0, rechecks date before release. No representable next day fails closed.

Storage successful write is followed by original-result read; all failures after successful write map to Unavailable. Backend post-write document failure likewise maps to Unavailable; application non-definite write errors and encoding failure return 503 RESULT_UNKNOWN. Known pre-COMMIT Domain permission/conflict/day failures remain 403/409 without current revision.

ReadOutcome filters receipt.last_actor_id against authenticated principal, including global admin; foreign and missing both become None. Original author still needs current scope/date/lease. Receipt preserves original record revision after later writes/clear. Payload fingerprint includes raw text while persisted record uses existing trim semantics; no automatic POST retry is introduced.

Validated identity bounds assignments<=4096/classes<=128. Compact sorted references are paged 20 at a time; homework numeric class/subject/owner sort with teacher-own vs global-all; reminders use all enabled managed classes. Offset>4096 or >total rejected, offset==total empty accepted; wire DTO nextOffset uses offset+items.length strictly below total.

Parent probe initializes owned DPAPI codec and SQLite plus an ordinarily approved exact Web lease; locks only its own local channel. Child exercises authenticated GET/POST scopes, wrong-CSRF nonmutation, durable homework/clear/CAS/idempotency/original result query and real desktop reminder facts. Output explicitly states synthetic request metadata and wire_TLS_browser_listener=NOT_RUN; parent closes/reopens owned DB and removes owned root.

limitations: No cargo, remote Windows command, browser, listener or TLS handshake was rerun for this read-only review; prior targeted host reports and root unified validation remain separate evidence.

Windows child diagnostic uses a single synthetic global account, one assignment and current real local date. It does not itself prove teacher/foreign-account permission edges, >20 pagination, controlled midnight/rollback, or injected post-COMMIT failures; those require the separate host tests/storage barriers and parent acceptance results.

Inspection is of the SHA-bound source and documented shared application-worker composition; it is not a formal proof of every possible scheduler interleaving or every later caller of the public Backend API.
No real classroom data, UI automation, user input injection or Windows SSH authorization change was used in this review.
